$description: EDH Seer's radii and border widths, extracted from the shipped stylesheet. THREE RADII, NOT EIGHT: index.css sets one `--radius: 0.5rem` for every panel and control, a full round for the pip, and a small round for inline code. A 6px/12px/16px/24px ladder existed here and nothing rendered it.

md.$description: 0.5rem - `--radius` and `--field-radius`: panels, cards, buttons, inputs. One value on purpose; a card and the input inside it sharing a corner is what makes the surfaces read as one system.

full.$description: the pip, and only the pip

thin.$description: every border and hairline in the product

medium.$description: the focus outline, and nothing else

default.$description: DECORATIVE - card edges, dividers. 1.32:1 on the page.

strong.$description: the only one that identifies a control at WCAG 1.4.11 (3.34:1)

focus.$description: drawn as an OUTLINE at 2px offset, not a border - so it never reflows the control it rings
